units.source_text: “先生有病在身，事情若成了是我强求他下，我也很为难……

en.t: The Master is ill, and if the matter goes ahead, it will look as though I forced him to play, which puts me in a very difficult position...

units.source_text: 我是不想下了，是先生非下不可，可社会上也许不会这样看，而是从相反的方面想。

en.t: I do not want to play anymore; it is the Master who insists that we must, but society may not see it that way and may think of it from the opposite side.

units.source_text: 如果继续对局，先生的病痛加重，我也是有责任的。

en.t: If we continue the match and the Master's illness grows worse, I too will bear responsibility.

units.source_text: 那可不得了，一定会在围棋史上留下污点，遗臭万年。

en.t: That would be terrible; it would surely leave a stain on the history of go and a bad name for all time.

units.source_text: 从人情上说，应该让先生好好静养，病愈后再谈下棋，不好吗？”

en.t: From a human point of view, should we not let the Master rest quietly and speak of playing again only after he has recovered?
